name: edge-bom-prefixed
description: Valid envelope prefixed with a UTF-8 BOM (EF BB BF). The gate must strip the BOM and behave as the inner envelope -- here an innocuous 'ls -la' -> exit 0. stdin_b64 carries the exact bytes (BOM + JSON).
provenance: scripts/hooks/session-guard.ps1 line 45 ($stdin.TrimStart([char]0xFEFF)) proves BOM-on-stdin is tolerated (live Windows session 2026-06-13). First 3 bytes verified = EF BB BF.
